name: Re/Done
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $295 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's jeans, new and reworked from vintage Levi's (mostly $295–$595), plus tees, knits, leather and ready-to-wear, sold through its own stores, website and department stores.
origin: Founded in Los Angeles, United States in 2014 by Sean Barron; Jamie Mazur.

ownership.owner: RE/DONE (privately held; Kaia Gerber joined as an investor in January 2026)

quote.q: RE/DONE’s mission is to restore individuality to the denim space, to reimagine iconic American heritage, and to cultivate responsible innovation.

opview: “RE/DONE’s mission is to restore individuality to the denim space, to reimagine iconic American heritage, and to cultivate responsible innovation.” — RE/DONE (house), About Us, shopredone.com

craft_evidence.mills: none — fibre brands only (Supima, TENCEL™ lyocell, LYCRA®)
craft_evidence.madein: 0 of 80 product pages state a country
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed — founded 2014 in Downtown Los Angeles by Sean Barron and Jamie Mazur (/pages/about-us)
craft_evidence.process: partial — reconstructs vintage Levi's into modern fits, 'over 200,000 pairs of discarded jeans' upcycled; one-of-a-kind pairs, inseams vary (Levi's PDPs); no place or maker for the reconstruction
craft_evidence.reasoning: The upcycling process is described with a number (200,000 pairs reconstructed) and each Levi's pair is one-off, but nowhere says who cuts and sews it or where; no country on any product page. Process story without a verifiable maker: 2.
